entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To check an order status, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand thing. It's ridiculous. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF78901. And don't give me a runaround, I've had it for a couple of weeks and I just want to send it back.

Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your order now. I see you have the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It doesn't matter! It's not what I wanted. I don't need to justify it to you. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm already writing a one-star review in my head.
That won't be necessary, Sam. I'm just checking our official return guidelines for you. One moment.
Unbelievable. Just look at your own policy. I'm sure I'm within the window.

You are absolutely correct, sir. I've confirmed it. Our company policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 17 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can process this return for you right now.
Oh. Okay. So... you're just going to do it? No problem?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Wow. Okay, great. That was... much easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Have a great day. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
